_comment: CrossLight BLE device signatures. Copy this to /bleaudit/signatures.json on the SD card. This is a VERIFIED STARTER LIST: every entry is a well-documented, strongly-sourced public identifier (each carries a 'source' field). It is meant to be extended -- add your own verified fingerprints from your own research. Low-confidence or unverified identifiers (e.g. a Tile manufacturer company ID, Pwnagotchi) were DELIBERATELY OMITTED rather than guessed; do not add an ID you cannot source. company_id and service_uuids are hex strings ('0x004C', '004C', or '4C'). A device matches a signature by its manufacturer company ID, OR any listed service UUID, OR any listed name_contains substring (case-insensitive).

signatures.name: Apple device
signatures.source: Bluetooth SIG Assigned Numbers, Company Identifiers: 0x004C = Apple, Inc. (covers iPhone/Watch/AirPods/FindMy advertisements; see per-device appleType byte).

signatures.name: Microsoft Swift Pair
signatures.source: Bluetooth SIG Assigned Numbers, Company Identifiers: 0x0006 = Microsoft; used by Swift Pair accessory beacons.

signatures.name: Tile tracker
signatures.source: Bluetooth SIG 16-bit UUIDs (member service UUIDs): 0xFEED = Tile, Inc.

signatures.name: Samsung SmartTag
signatures.source: Bluetooth SIG 16-bit UUIDs (member service UUIDs): 0xFD5A and 0xFD59 = Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. (SmartThings/SmartTag).

signatures.name: Eddystone beacon
signatures.source: Google Eddystone protocol specification: service UUID 0xFEAA (also registered to Google in the Bluetooth SIG 16-bit UUID list).

signatures.name: Google Fast Pair
signatures.source: Bluetooth SIG 16-bit UUIDs (member service UUIDs): 0xFE2C = Google LLC; used by Fast Pair advertisements.

signatures.name: Flipper Zero
signatures.source: Flipper Zero advertises a BLE local name beginning with 'Flipper' (default device name 'Flipper <name>'). name_contains is a hint: a user-renamed device will not match.
